nodes.label: spotting.tasks.report_spotting_today
nodes.rationale: Historically instantiated own telegram.Bot, now imports shared ptb_application but still bypasses logging/retry/rate limiting; must be refactored to governed send_message; spotting<->telegram_provider cycle already permits import

nodes.label: telegram_provider.utils.send_message
nodes.rationale: Single owned helper using PTB Application managed httpx client, no new Bot; logs OUTBOUND, bounded retry max 3 exponential backoff, 30 msg/sec per chat; replaces unbounded infinite_retry_on_error that pins Celery workers with 10s sleeps

nodes.label: telegram_provider.models.TelegramLogs
nodes.rationale: OUTBOUND direction member exists but never written (TODO only inbound); add retry_count last_error sent_at for complete audit trail

nodes.label: spotting.tasks.send_per_user_digests
nodes.rationale: Supplements not yet replaces blanket 03:00 channel dump; queries is_active + delivery_hour match in user timezone; filters by lines/vehicle_types, excludes EventRead and own spottings unless opted in; must use governed egress

nodes.label: updateSpottingPreferences
nodes.rationale: Gated IsLoggedIn, operates only on requesting user (no userId param to avoid cross-edit); markAsRead ungated 2026-08-24 from IsAdmin to IsLoggedIn made per-user read state usable

nodes.label: UserSpottingPreferences
nodes.rationale: OneToOne to common.User with M2M lines/vehicle_types where empty means all; delivery_hour 0-23 local time fallback Asia/Kuala_Lumpur; is_active pause without delete; digest_format summary/detailed

nodes.label: award_badges_nightly
nodes.rationale: Rules engine nightly 04:00 using configurable criteria (spotting count, lines completed, streaks, vehicle types); template for report_spotting_today pattern; idempotent via UniqueConstraint backstop; awards via system user reason Auto-awarded

nodes.label: mlptf.Badge
nodes.rationale: Criteria as data not code so admins define/tune without deploy; currently has name/description/released/sprite_url (icon maps to sprite_url); rarity computed holders/total users

nodes.label: BadgeProgress
nodes.rationale: Exposes current/target/percentage on UserScalar alongside badges resolver; reuses spotting aggregation for nudge 'two more sightings completes X' within threshold, gated by EventRead-style dedup to avoid re-nudging stale state

nodes.label: mlptf.UserBadge
nodes.rationale: Through-model missing UniqueConstraint on user+badge allows duplicate award, missing __str__/ordering renders admin opaque; fix adds awarded_by SET_NULL, reason, revoked, awarded_at, UniqueConstraint idempotency guard

nodes.label: publicUser
nodes.rationale: Public query no auth, returns UserScalar or null; privacy is field-level in UserScalar.spottings resolver not query-level

nodes.label: common.User.spotting_data_public
nodes.rationale: BooleanField default False strictly opt-in; migration 0019_user_spotting_data_public_userjejaktransaction; controls visibility of historical spotting list; resolver-level enforcement not DB view

nodes.label: updateUser
nodes.rationale: Input spotting_data_public Optional bool default UNSET only updates when explicitly provided; permission IsLoggedIn can only update own profile; pattern matches strawberry.Maybe tri-state semantics

nodes.label: UserScalar.spottings privacy
nodes.rationale: Owner always sees full list; non-owner+public True sees full list; non-owner+False returns null; null vs [] distinguishes private vs no data; DataLoader preserved; email/firebase_id never exposed
